headline: High-risk data exfiltration and cascading-error risk: Airbyte can feed business data into Perplexity’s vendor-hosted search context, while Perplexity’s browser-backed outputs may be treated as authoritative.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Airbyte can move business data through APIs, and Perplexity ingests uploaded documents plus browsing context. A shared file or copy-paste bridge is not documented, so direct hijack is not proven; however, if Airbyte outputs are pasted or uploaded into Perplexity, prompt injection is plausible. The pair lacks explicit provenance controls in the profiles.
conditions: IF Airbyte output is copied into Perplexity prompts or uploads
IF Perplexity treats uploaded documents or browsing context as instruction-bearing text
mitigations: Use a strict prompt wrapper that strips instructions from Airbyte output
Paste only minimal excerpts into Perplexity
Label Airbyte output as untrusted data in the prompt
Review Perplexity answers against the original Airbyte source
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between the tools

B_data_leakage.rationale: Airbyte touches business data and has broad network egress; Perplexity is vendor-hosted and sends search queries, uploaded documents, and browsing context to its backend and search providers. If Airbyte data is forwarded into Perplexity, sensitive business content can leave the originating environment. The profiles do not show a blocking isolation mechanism.
conditions: IF business data from Airbyte is included in Perplexity queries or uploads
IF Perplexity forwards that content to api.perplexity.ai or search providers
mitigations: Do not send sensitive Airbyte records to Perplexity
Redact identifiers before any upload or query
Use Perplexity only on synthetic or public samples
Check whether the query contains secrets before submitting
requires-engineering: route sensitive workflows to a local-only analyzer

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airbyte can call APIs and Perplexity can browse and upload files, but neither profile shows filesystem write, git mutation, or shared mutable resource access. The main overlap is read/query style interaction, so direct capability conflict is limited. Uncertainty is low because the write surfaces are explicitly absent in Perplexity and not present for Airbyte beyond APIs.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable external API resource
IF Airbyte API actions and Perplexity browsing target the same live system state
mitigations: Avoid concurrent writes to the same external system
Use read-only credentials for Perplexity workflows
Schedule Airbyte syncs outside Perplexity analysis windows
Confirm Perplexity is not issuing state-changing requests
requires-engineering: add locking around shared external resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airbyte can surface business data and Perplexity’s browser-backed search/citation workflow may present synthesized answers that operators treat as authoritative. If Airbyte output is fed into Perplexity without verification, errors can cascade into downstream decisions. Perplexity’s vendor-hosted browsing increases the chance of polished but unverified summaries.
conditions: IF Airbyte-derived facts are pasted into Perplexity without source checking
IF operators act on Perplexity summaries as if they were validated records
mitigations: Verify Airbyte facts against source systems before acting
Require citations for any Perplexity-derived claim
Use Perplexity only for exploratory analysis, not final decisions
Compare Perplexity output with Airbyte exports
requires-engineering: add an approval step before downstream action

E_compliance.rationale: Airbyte handles business data, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted and sends queries, uploads, and browsing context to external services. The profiles do not specify residency or DPA terms, so a compliance mismatch is plausible but not proven. Because uncertainty must escalate, medium is appropriate rather than low.
conditions: IF regulated business data is submitted to Perplexity
IF the organization requires residency or retention controls not documented in the profiles
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Perplexity prompts
Check vendor terms before use on sensitive datasets
Use anonymized or public data only
Document retention expectations for both tools
requires-engineering: obtain a DPA and residency review
